intro: Dunemaul Compound serves as the central settlement and ogre mound for the Dunemaul clan in Tanaris. Tucked into the rocky ridges bordering the desert wastes, it houses the clan's brute enforcers and spellcasters.

p: Carved into the rugged desert rock of western Tanaris, the Dunemaul Compound is the primary stronghold of the Dunemaul ogres. These hulking desert dwellers have adapted to the harsh arid climate, scratching out an existence through brute force and opportunism. The compound itself centers on an ogre mound and cave network. Though primitive, the clan fields a dangerous mix of warriors, enforcers, and twisted spellcasters practicing dark warlock and mage magics. For travelers journeying across the dunes, the settlement is a treacherous den of aggressive giants who violently reject uninvited guests.
